question: Should Control UI add a per-click Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default copy-format preference, or keep the current markdown-only copy behavior for now?
rationale: The source confirms the missing feature, but the issue intentionally offers multiple UX shapes and the repository labels already mark this as needing product direction before automation.

options.title: Add Compact Copy Menu
options.body: Keep the existing default behavior and add a small menu or split-button that lets each assistant message be copied as Markdown or converted plain text.

options.title: Add Persisted Preference
options.body: Let users set a default copy format, which may be more convenient but adds preference surface and upgrade/test work for a low-priority UX feature.

options.title: Leave Markdown Only
options.body: Close or defer the feature if maintainers decide the extra copy surface is not worth the UI complexity right now.

recommendation.title: Add Compact Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Keep the existing default behavior and add a small menu or split-button that lets each assistant message be copied as Markdown or converted plain text.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current copy-as-markdown behavior and already framed the open product question in the issue discussion.
